post.description:
Manually initiates the 'C01_Initiate_Procedural_Load_Sequence' diagnostic protocol. This operation performs a comprehensive deep-scan of the system architecture, verifying integrity across all logic gates, memory banks, and peripheral interfaces. It is designed to simulate high-load environments to detect potential failures before production deployment. 

WARNING: This operation consumes significant computational resources and may temporarily degrade performance of concurrent processes.

parameters.name: trace_id
parameters.description: A unique UUID for distributed tracing across microservices during the diagnostic run.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: If set to true, the system simulates the diagnostic steps without executing the actual hardware interrupts.

parameters.name: priority_level
parameters.description: Determines the scheduler priority for the diagnostic task.

requestBody.description: Configuration payload for the diagnostic sequence, allowing specific subsystem targeting and parameter overrides.

target_modules.description: List of specific modules to include in the diagnostic scan. If empty, all modules are scanned.

load_parameters.description: Parameters defining the intensity of the synthetic load generated during testing.

memory_allocation_mb.description: Amount of RAM to reserve for integrity testing.

io_operations_per_second.description: Target IOPS for storage controller stress testing.

notification_webhook.description: Optional URL to receive a POST callback upon diagnostic completion.

full_system_check.description: Initiates the standard C01 sequence across all modules with default stress parameters.

memory_only_check.description: Runs the C01 sequence isolated to the MMU.

202.description: Accepted. The diagnostic sequence has been queued for execution.

Location.description: URI to poll for the status of the diagnostic job.

X-Job-ID.description: The unique identifier assigned to this diagnostic job.

job_id.description: Unique reference ID for the queued job.

estimated_completion_time.description: Projected timestamp for completion based on current system load.

queue_position.description: Current position in the execution queue.

400.description: Bad Request. The configuration payload contains invalid parameters or unsupported modules.

value.message: The module 'quantum_core' is not recognized or not available for diagnostic C01.

401.description: Unauthorized. The request lacks valid authentication credentials or the user lacks permission to trigger system-level diagnostics.

409.description: Conflict. A diagnostic sequence is already running and concurrent execution is not permitted.

value.message: Diagnostic lock held by job ID 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000.

503.description: Service Unavailable. The diagnostic subsystem is currently offline for maintenance.
